item.title: How to debug Angular with Augury
item.description: Debugging Angular applications with Augury provides visual inspection of component hierarchy, state, and dependency injection. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve used Augury to debug complex component trees in enterprise applications. Augury is a Chrome and Firefox extension that extends browser DevTools with Angular-specific debugging capabilities. This approach helps you visualize component relationships, inspect properties, and understand application structure.
